notes.title: Meet Pin Zhi, our first release!
notes.content:
Kuzuzangpo la! / Greetings!

We are very happy and proud to let you know that Pin Zhi is released on Steam! 
It's the first video game made from our country Bhutan, a kingdom that lies in the heart of the Himalayas:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=42bNQmN_j0c

Pin Zhi is a 2D adventure game inspired by The Four Harmonious Brothers (Thuenpha Phuenzhi), a symbolic story of Bhutan. Step into a world rich with culture and tradition, where the breathtaking scenery invites you to explore the timeless tales and vibrant heritage of Bhutan.

With Pin Zhi we want to show our own people but also you as a player that it can be done, a video game about Bhutan and one of its tales, told through a game and for the world to enjoy. The release of Pin Zhi is about the experience and the encouragement to others in the country to join them, grow and learn to make better games in the future. 

Hope you will enjoy playing Pin Zhi :)

Tashi Delek / Best wishes
